summary: Full CMS testing (backend + frontend) for Mr. Coconetto admin panel. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/me + 401 on bad), content GET/PUT (auth-gated, deep-merge preserves untouched keys), products list/get/create/update/delete + slug uniqueness, order PATCH+DELETE by admin, upload-logo. Frontend: admin login -> /admin dashboard OK; all 5 tabs switch; SEO title save reflected in document.title on /; Content-tab Hero.subheading save reflected on / after reload; Product Add + Save appears on public /products; Product Delete removes it; Editing existing product tagline (personalized-coconut) reflects on /products; Admin bar appears when logged in and hides after logout; Edit Mode toggles inline editors; contentEditable Hero.subheading edit persists to DB and shows on reload; admin-bar-dashboard navigates to /admin; admin-bar-logout logs out; public /products and /products/:slug render fine when logged out. All test-created data reverted (test product deleted; hero.subheading, seo.title, tagline restored to originals).
critical_code_review_comments: ContentEditor: `Save Content` sends `{brand, hero, about}` but omits `seo`; that's fine since SEO has its own Save. Non-blocking.

AdminDashboard.jsx is 293 lines with multiple sub-components (ProductEditor, ContentEditor, SeoEditor, ImageField, GalleryAdder) — consider splitting into /components/admin/* files for maintainability (still under the 700-line rule but growing).
SiteContent.saveContent silently swallows errors (`catch (e) {}`) — an auth expiry or 400 on inline edit will be invisible to the admin. Consider surfacing via a toast.
ProductEditor keeps `features` as newline string in state; Save button converts on click — OK but the parent `saveProduct` also does the same conversion. Minor duplication, no bug.
delProduct uses window.confirm which blocks; fine for now but not consistent with the rest of the toast UX.
Editable.EditableText saves on every blur — even when unchanged. Not a bug but generates unnecessary PUTs; consider dirty check.
seed_data_creation: All test artifacts cleaned up: TEST_UI_Product deleted; hero.subheading, seo.title, personalized-coconut tagline reverted to originals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_cms.py (13 tests, run via `pytest backend/tests/test_cms.py`). Inline live-editor requires real focus/blur (not synthetic FocusEvent) because contentEditable relies on React's onBlur. Use `element.click()` -> `keyboard.press('Control+A')` -> `keyboard.type(...)` -> click elsewhere to trigger save. Object-storage upload works; the /api/upload-logo endpoint returns `{path, url}` and the frontend prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to the returned relative url.
